# A pile of fallen blocks with moss (generated by make_env.py), about 2.2 x 1.1 x 1.8 m. Origin on the floor.
new
material new Block --base-color 0.5608 0.5765 0.5373 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.3216 0.3255 0.2980 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.3647 0.4627 0.2627 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Block0 --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.350
scale 1.00 0.80 0.70
apply --scale
set rotation -0.8 0.7 18
apply --rotation
material assign Block
add mesh cube --name Block1 --size 1 --location 0.800 -0.400 0.275
scale 0.80 0.70 0.55
apply --scale
set rotation 6.8 -0.4 -25
apply --rotation
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Block2 --size 1 --location -0.700 -0.300 0.250
scale 0.70 0.60 0.50
apply --scale
set rotation 0.1 1.0 40
apply --rotation
material assign Block
add mesh cube --name Block3 --size 1 --location 0.200 0.600 0.225
scale 0.60 0.50 0.45
apply --scale
set rotation -5.0 0.1 70
apply --rotation
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Block4 --size 1 --location 0.350 -0.150 0.875
scale 0.60 0.55 0.45
apply --scale
set rotation 2.1 3.5 -8
apply --rotation
material assign Block
add mesh cone --name MossCap --vertices 6 --radius1 0.42 --radius2 0.2 --depth 0.12 --location 0.350 -0.150 1.260
material assign Moss
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.24 --location -1.100 0.400 0.160
material assign Trim
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.18 --location 1.200 0.500 0.120
material assign Block
select all
shade flat
export rubble.glb
